translation.title: Hydrocortisone Lotion
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for eczema and dermatitis, skin itching, and insect bites.
translation.usage: Shake well before use, then apply an appropriate amount to the affected area 1 to 3 times a day. The amount may be increased or decreased as appropriate to the symptoms. Limit the treatment period to within 7 days.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, or if you have a skin infection caused by bacteria (such as tuberculosis or syphilis), fungi (such as candidiasis or tinea), viruses (such as shingles, herpes simplex blisters, chickenpox, or vaccinia), or animal parasites (such as scabies or pubic lice); eczematous otitis externa with a perforated eardrum; an ulcer (except Behcet's disease); a deep second-degree or worse burn or frostbite; perioral dermatitis; acne vulgaris; rosacea; or non-inflammatory itching. Before using it, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant or may be pregnant or are breastfeeding, for infants and children (especially infants under 2 years), or for the elderly. Do not use it in the eyes, or for non-therapeutic purposes such as after makeup or shaving. Do not use an occlusive dressing without a doctor's supervision. Do not use it for a long period. Stop use and consult a doctor or pharmacist if adverse reactions occur, such as bacterial (impetigo, folliculitis) or fungal (candidiasis, tinea) skin infections, folliculitis, boils, skin irritation, a stinging pain, fever, a burning sensation, rash, redness, flushing, itching, dry skin, pustular dermatitis, allergic contact dermatitis, heat rash, worsening of wounds, pressure sores, pustulosis, or very rarely hives, skin exfoliation, changes in pigmentation, or irritation and pain at the application site.
